target_customer: Owners of real estate and industrial assets and their contractors running construction projects
problem: Construction projects slip because field data, checklists, compliance and communication are scattered. Bulldozair put field data collection and reporting on one web and mobile platform.
business_model: B2B SaaS for large enterprise customers

founders.name: Ali El Hariri
founders.background_notes: YC profile says 15 years in construction technology. FrenchWeb calls him a construction engineer.

founders.name: Maxence Lerigner
founders.background_notes: FrenchWeb calls him a software engineer.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile and web forms, plans and reporting platform, standard engineering with offline field capture as the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Once deployed across a company's projects the archive and workflows create some lock in, but the category had many similar tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Larger construction software firms existed but none acquired it. Infopro Digital bought it in 2024 to join its Mezzoteam platform.

market_need_then: Owners faced delays and compliance reporting that the company said took weeks by hand. No dated 2016 spend data was found.

branding.domain_note: Used bulldozair.com, which now redirects to the Mezzoteam site after the acquisition.

rebrands.why: Domain redirects to Mezzoteam after the Infopro Digital acquisition; the company registry also lists earlier names including Ugly Ducklings and Gozair.

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence of community or merch. It won a pitch prize at VivaTech per an Anaxago headline.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive pun name that is a spelling risk, with brand recognition limited to French construction circles in the sources found.

outcome_analysis: Bulldozair sold construction tracking software to large corporate owners in France and abroad, raised a 4 million euro round in November 2020 from PROBTP Innovation and Anaxago, and was sold to Infopro Digital in February 2024 alongside Formi. The sellers included the founders and its investors. Price is not public. It reached a strategic exit rather than a venture scale outcome as far as sources show.
notes: The 2020 round is 4,000,000 euros; amount_usd left null rather than converting. FrenchWeb does not state a stage, so it is recorded as other, a CFNews headline calls a round a series A but was not opened. YC page says founded 2012, FrenchWeb says 2013. Kima Ventures, Station F and YC are named as backers on the YC page; no amounts found. Finalcad (raised 40M in Dec 2018) was named in a 2020 article, so it is not recorded as a 2016 competitor; no dated 2016 competitor source was found. The mezzoteam.fr page was not fetched.
